野马遍地都是，但真正值得养的只有几匹：金色马、巨马和几匹高属性野马，本篇一次讲清位置和驯法。

Wild horses are everywhere, but only a few are truly worth raising: the Golden Horse, the Giant Horse, and a few high-stat wild horses. This guide covers their locations and taming methods in one place.

马在王国之泪里不只是代步：赶路、拉货、跑图都靠它。普通野马随处可抓，但属性参差不齐；金色马和巨马是固定出现的稀有马，值得专门规划一趟。下面讲清每匹马的位置、驯服要点和后续养护。

Horses in Tears of the Kingdom are more than just transport: getting around, hauling cargo, and covering the map all depend on them. Ordinary wild horses can be caught anywhere, but their stats vary widely; the Golden Horse and the Giant Horse are rare horses that appear at fixed locations and are worth planning a dedicated trip for. Below, we explain each horse's location, taming tips, and follow-up care.

The Golden Horse quest is accepted at Snowfield Stable, but you must first start the 'Potential Princess Sightings!' series at the Lucky Clover Gazette; the rewards are the Royal Saddle and Royal Bridle.

On the way to the Golden Horse, keep to the left to avoid the nearby Frost Gleeok.

常见问题
FAQ
抓马的流程都一样：蹲下潜行靠近，趁马没发现跳上马背，然后在马挣扎时不停按安抚，直到马平静下来。精力不够会在中途被甩下来，所以出发前先看精力圈数，备好精力料理。马的四维是力量、速度、精力、牵引，星数越高越好，性格温顺的马安抚起来更省精力。

Catching a horse always follows the same steps: crouch and sneak up, jump onto its back before it notices you, then keep pressing Soothe while it struggles until it calms down. If you run out of stamina, you will be thrown off midway, so check how many Stamina Wheels you have before setting out and prepare stamina dishes. A horse's four stats are Strength, Speed, Stamina, and Pull — the more stars, the better — and a gentle-tempered horse takes less stamina to soothe.
金色马在北塔邦挞雪原遗迹附近，坐标约（-1818，3380，0236）。它的属性是力量四星、速度四星、精力三星、牵引两星，性格温顺，是全游戏综合最值得养的马之一。相关任务“塞尔达所爱的金色的马”在雪原驿站接，但要先在白诘报社开启“传言中的塞尔达公主”系列任务线，否则驿站不会给你这个任务。

The Golden Horse is near the North Tabantha Snowfield ruins, at approximately (-1818, 3380, 0236). Its stats are Strength 4 stars, Speed 4 stars, Stamina 3 stars, and Pull 2 stars, and with its gentle temperament it is one of the most worthwhile horses to raise in the whole game. The related quest, 'Zelda's Golden Horse,' is accepted at Snowfield Stable, but you must first start the 'Potential Princess Sightings!' questline at the Lucky Clover Gazette, or the stable will not offer you this quest.
驯服约需两圈精力，提前吃精力料理或带足料理再去。去的路上注意附近有冰之三头龙古栗欧克，贴左走可以避开它，别在龙的地盘里跟马纠缠。完成任务后奖励王族马鞍和王族缰绳，都是金色马的专属外观。

Taming it takes about two Stamina Wheels, so eat stamina dishes in advance or bring enough dishes with you. On the way there, watch out for the nearby Frost Gleeok — keeping to the left lets you avoid it, and do not tangle with a horse on the dragon's turf. After completing the quest, you are rewarded with the Royal Saddle and Royal Bridle, both exclusive looks for the Golden Horse.
金色马的特写
Close-up of the Golden Horse
金色马：力量与速度都是四星（游戏实机截图）
The Golden Horse: both Strength and Speed are 4 stars (in-game screenshot)
巨马在马神湖南边木桥一带的山谷出没，体型比普通马大得多，力量极高，但驯服耗精力极多，没有三圈以上的精力准备不要硬上。巨马适合拉重物和冲撞，不适合竞速，养之前先想清楚用途。普通野马里也有高属性个体，看到四星速度或力量的马值得抓下来对比，属性比名字更重要。

The Giant Horse roams the valley around the wooden bridge south of the Horse God Lake. It is much larger than an ordinary horse, with extremely high Strength, but taming it drains a huge amount of stamina — do not try it without more than three Stamina Wheels' worth of preparation. The Giant Horse is good for hauling heavy loads and charging through enemies, but not for racing, so decide what you want it for before raising it. Among ordinary wild horses there are also high-stat individuals; if you see a horse with 4-star Speed or Strength, it is worth catching and comparing, since stats matter more than names.
马神马泷在东阿卡莱驿站附近。用速速红萝卜（毅力胡萝卜）唤醒她之后，她可以强化马匹属性，也能复活死去的马。马死了不用重抓，带上材料找马泷就能复活；想把主力马的属性再往上推，也要来找她。

The Horse God Malanya is near East Akkala Stable. After waking her with Endura Carrots, she can upgrade horses' stats and revive horses that have died. If a horse dies, you do not need to catch it again — bring the materials to Malanya and she can revive it; and if you want to push your main horse's stats even higher, you need to come to her too.
在任意驿站登录马匹需要 20 卢比，登录后可以在任何驿站取马。养马不用贪多：留一匹速度快的赶路马、一匹力量大的拉货马（巨马）、一匹金色马做主力就够了，马槽满了反而每次取马都要翻半天。

Registering a horse at any stable costs 20 Rupees, and once registered you can pick it up at any stable. Do not be greedy about how many horses you keep: one fast horse for travel, one strong horse for hauling (the Giant Horse), and one Golden Horse as your main mount are enough — a full stable just means flipping through pages every time you pick up a horse.
